questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: After 'Little' at the start of a sentence, use inversion with 'did': Little did he know.
questions.wrong: Little he knew that his life was about to change.
solutions: Little did he know that his life was about to change.

questions.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Rewrite it correctly.
questions.explanation: Inverted second conditional: 'Were I you' (no 'to be' after 'Were I').
questions.wrong: Were I to be you, I would accept the offer.
solutions: Were I you, I would accept the offer.
If I were you, I would accept the offer.
